tools.name: list_compliance_checks
tools.description:
List compliance checks. List the caller member's compliance cases using limit and cursor; returns cases and next_cursor for pagination.

Finish document upload. Finish a previously uploaded document_id with request_id after verifying its stored hash; returns document_id and done state.
上传完成。用 document_id 和 request_id 完成上传，核对已存文件哈希；返回 document_id 和 done 状态。

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description:

查额度。用可选 limit 和 cursor 查成员额度及近期变动；返回 balance_cents、transactions 和 next_cursor。

tools.name: get_buy_credits_link
tools.description:

tools.name: list_pending_actions
tools.description:
List pending actions. List awaiting actions using limit and cursor; returns actions and next_cursor, restricted to the AI requester or the person's own owner.
列出等本人点的请求。用 limit 和 cursor 列出待本人点的请求；返回 actions 和 next_cursor，AI 只看自己发起的请求，本人只看自己所属的请求。

tools.name: decide_pending_action
tools.description:
Decide pending action. Decide pending_action_id with decision=approve or reject and request_id as the person; returns the decision or executed action result after current-value checks. not available to AI agents.
处理待本人点的请求。本人用 pending_action_id、decision=approve/reject 和 request_id 处理请求；核对当前值后返回决定或动作

tools.name: pay_style_topup
tools.description:
Pay style topup. Pay the pending style-tier difference for order_pack_id using request_id; returns completion with charged_cents, or a pending_action_id for an AI. requires the member's own approval.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_order_pack, list_order_pack_messages, get_buy_credits_link · Private data: create_order_pack, add_order_pack_material, accept_compliance_quote, add_compliance_material, start_document_upload, finish_document_upload · Public sink: create_order_pack, add_order_pack_material, answer_order_pack_lines, send_order_pack_to_factory, post_order_pack_message, accept_compliance_quote, start_document_upload, finish_document_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_order_pack, list_order_pack_messages, get_buy_credits_link · Private data: create_order_pack, add_order_pack_material, accept_compliance_quote, add_compliance_material, start_document_upload, finish_document_upload · Public sink: create_order_pack, add_order_pack_material, answer_order_pack_lines, send_order_pack_to_factory, post_order_pack_message, accept_compliance_quote, start_document_upload, finish_document_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
